Adjacent paragraphs retain independent fills and borders; unshaded content stays unshaded in independently reopened DOCX.
Live footer PAGE field renders 1 and 2 with the entire authored title suffix; field and suffix retain bold blue 14pt styling.
Otherwise identical adjacent paragraphs keep independent tab positions, left/right/center alignment and dot/hyphen/underscore/plain leaders. A repeated configuration remains equivalent.
An authored row height is a minimum: all four lines remain visible and increase the first row beyond 18pt; the short second row reserves at least 72pt. Reopened DOCX must retain atLeast rules.
Mixed-case six-digit cell colors retain their RGB values. An invalid color is omitted while all four authored 0.5pt black borders survive; an undecorated neighbor inherits no custom fill.
